name: MicroHack-AppInnovation
postCreateCommand: az version && azd version && dotnet --info && { [ -n "$MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD" ] || echo 'NOTE: MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD is unset on your host, so it is empty here. Nothing in this repository reads it and the container is fully usable without it. If you start a SQL Server container for local .NET work it will refuse to start with "Password validation failed", because it inherits the empty value. To fix that, set a strong password in your HOST shell (bash: export MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=...  PowerShell: $env:MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=...) and rebuild this container. Never commit the value.'; }
